summary: Implemented provider property media upload/order/remove, contract-backed contact details, and review/submit screens for PRV-08 through PRV-10. The UI uses only implemented provider routes, keeps media session-local because no media-list GET route exists, and excludes private storage identifiers and unsupported internal fields.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified as the direct route integration exception required to render the selected completion screens.

The current API exposes media mutations but no provider media-list GET route and PropertyData has no media field; the UI therefore shows only media returned by mutations in the current editor session and states the unavailable prior list honestly.
The approved design includes fields that are not in the current contact contract; internal notes and unsupported visibility fields were not invented or submitted.
The review acknowledgement checkboxes are local UI gating only. Server availableActions, version, validation, authorization, and ownership remain authoritative.
An initial full web-suite invocation exposed an unrelated timing failure in provider-organization-documents; the focused test and complete rerun both passed, and no onboarding file was changed.
knownGaps: No direct in-app browser connector evidence was available because its sandbox metadata was unavailable; executable Playwright visual and accessibility journeys passed.
Provider-specific external storage readiness remains an environment concern; local tests use deterministic route fixtures and the runtime fails closed when storage/scanning is unavailable.
This task does not claim full API, Backend, screen, or platform completion.
